data.description: This lab allows the artificer to spend 4 hours crafting each night while out adventuring, and net 3 hours' worth of work.  However,the skill check to complete a magic item that had any of its work done using a portable lab takes a -5 penalty.
data.name: Artificer's Lab (Portable)
